name: vm-babysitter
description: Automatic Backup & Monitoring utility for QEMU/KVM Virtual Machines (powered by Virtnbdbackup) Features: - Manages a list of *non-transient* domains defined in QEMU to be backed up regularly via internal cron task - Checks backup chains integrity of all listed domains, being able to detect inconsistencies and proceed accordingly (e.g. fixing, discarding, creating new ones, etc.) - Configurable backup rotation and retention policy - Ability to create a mirror and keep it updated with Rsync right after backup schedule or at configurable one, with independent retention policy - All main tasks (backup, sync, rotation/retention) can be performed manually by the user from inside the container - Pseudo-interactive tools for domain replication (to local and remote endpoints) and recovery from backups on the local host - Notify about backup chain and Rsync start and end of activities, as also when user intervention is required and about errors (Unraid feature) - Assume a different behavior when detects the server has been started recently, assuming the possibility of a previous crash, and therefore a more strict check of backup chains (Unraid feature)

paths.name: Path for Backups (local)
paths.description: Path to user share where all backups will be stored

paths.name: SSH Key
paths.description: Path to private SSH key to perform operations onto remote servers via SSH and Rsync. Key must be owned by root and file permissions equal to '0600' (in most cases, necessary for send Unraid notifications)

paths.name: Path for Domain Disk Images
paths.description: Change only if domain disk images are stored into a different user share than the default

paths.name: Main Path for Logs
paths.description: Persistent bind mount for log files generated by scripts

paths.name: Virtnbdbackup Socket
paths.description: Allows Virtnbdbackup to put its socket onto the main host

paths.name: Libvirt API Socket
paths.description: Allow scripts to read and interact with Libvirt socket from inside the container

paths.name: Lock Folder
paths.description: Allow scripts to put locks onto the main host

paths.name: Path to Nvram Binaries
paths.description: Allow scripts to read/restore per domain nvram binaries for EFI/UEFI boot

paths.name: Path to OVMF Binaries
paths.description: Allow scripts to read/copy common nvram binaries for EFI/UEFI boot

variables.name: Time Zone
variables.description: Set container to a desired timezone (usually same as this host)

variables.name: Autostart Domains
variables.description: Space separated list of domains that will be started along with the container if found powered off (case sensitive)

variables.name: Ignored Domains
variables.description: Space separated list of domains to exclude from backup schedule and automatic checks (case sensitive)

variables.name: Backups Rotation (local)
variables.description: Backups rotation: Number of checkpoints to save incrmentally into a backup chain before to archive it. If set to `0`, backup chain will grow indefinitely (and no retention policies will be applied)

variables.name: Backup Schedule
variables.description: Cron expression to schedule incremental backups

variables.name: Retention Policy (local)
variables.description: Local retention policy: How many backup chains to keep archived at `LOCAL_BACKUP_PATH`. If set to `0`, disables retention policy on the local endpoint

variables.name: Unraid IP/Hostname
variables.description: Unraid IP/Hostname to send notifications (usually, same as this host). It has no effect on non-Unraid OS

variables.name: Path for Backups (mirror)
variables.description: Usually, a SSH address to a path into another host, where backup chains will be mirrored. Requires r/w permissions at the remote host. If not set, this feature remains disabled and `RSYNC_` env vars have no effect. (Read documentation for advanced usage)

variables.name: Rsync Schedule
variables.description: When a cron expression is set, backup mirrors are updated at this specific schedule, instead of immediately after backups schedule

variables.name: Retention Policy (mirror)
variables.description: Mirror's retention policy: How many backup chains to keep archived at `RSYNC_BACKUP_PATH`. If set to `0`, disables retention policy on the mirror

variables.name: Fix Backup Chains After Interrupted Tasks
variables.description: Attempts to repair backup chains when virtnbdbackup was interrupted in the middle of an operation, by removing the last checkpoint at both backup and domain, avoiding thus a forced rotation and creation of a new backup chain. (Set a non-empty value to enable)

variables.name: Allow Automatic Powercycle of Domains
variables.description: Performs controlled powercycle of running domains under certain scenarios during container startup. If not set, vm-babysitter will ask the user (via logs and Unraid notifications, when available) to manually shut down domains in need of this action. Read documentation for more info (Set a non-empty string to enable)

variables.name: Check Backups Data Integrity
variables.description: Verify data integrity of backups. This operation may take long time, delaying container's full initialization. Only useful under suspect of data corruption (Set a non-empty value to enable)

variables.name: Domain Awaiting Timeout
variables.description: Max amount in seconds scripts will await for domains responding to libvirt queries during powercycle operations. Increase this value if you get often warnings about scripts 'giving up' awaiting for slow domains

variables.name: Virtnbdbackup Extra Arguments
variables.description: Extra arguments passed to virtnbdbackup (only tested with `--start-domain`, `--compress` and `--no-color`. Other combinations usually lead to unexpected results

variables.name: Rsync Extra Arguments
variables.description: Extra arguments passed to Rsync

variables.name: SSH Options
variables.description: Common SSH options for communications with remote, and the unraid hosts (expert use only)

variables.name: Internal Path for Backups
variables.description: Container path where vm-babysitter will save and vm-restore will search for backups. Container will not start if not set, or if not mounted in r/w mode

variables.name: Internal Main Log Path
variables.description: Container path for the main log file

variables.name: Internal Schedule Log Path
variables.description: Container path for scheduled tasks log file

variables.name: Internal Logrotate Config Path
variables.description: Container path to place and read log rotation config

variables.name: Logrotate Schedule
variables.description: Cron expression to schedule internal logs rotation

variables.name: Logrotate Settings
variables.value:
compress
  copytruncate
  daily
  dateext
  dateformat .%Y-%m-%d.%H:%M:%S
  missingok
  notifempty
  rotate 30
variables.description: Parsed string with *escaped* logrotate config to `LOGROTATE_CONFIG_PATH` during container (re)start
